description: Reconfigure an existing source — rename it, change its schedule, repoint its field mapping, or pause and resume it. A true patch: omitted arguments are left as they are. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES update_source"]

config.description: Replacement provider config (replaces the whole object, so changing one key means sending the current config from list_sources with that key changed). May include conflict_policy: "external_wins" (default) | "storyos_wins" | "newest_wins", write_back (required true before any "out"/"both" field_mapping entry actually pushes — see create_source's description), and require_approval_for_push (default false — holds each push as an Inbox approval instead of sending it immediately).

connection_id.description: Point the source at a different stored connection.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id.

external_key_field.description: Field (name or id) holding the provider's stable id.

field_mapping.description: { "provider_external_key": "field name or id" } or { "provider_external_key": { field, direction } } (direction "in"/"out"/"both") — the COMPLETE mapping, which replaces the existing one.

status.description: "paused" stops the schedule without discarding the source; "active" resumes it.

name: update_source
title: Update source
